data.narrative:
Anduril Industries is a Series H defense and security company founded by Palmer Luckey, Brian Schimpf, Trae Stephens, Matt Grimm, and Joe Chen, currently valued at $61B with $11B+ raised to date. The relevant comparison universe includes 2 public comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers spanning the defense sector, including Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, Quantum-Systems, and Flock Safety.

A peer-median triangulation method proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow peer clustering. While 20 same-sector peers exist in Defense & Security, none met the threshold of three or more datapoints when filtered by stage, adjacent stage, or valuation tier. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias given Anduril's specialized positioning and capital intensity. The sparse addressable comp set reflects the scarcity of late-stage private defense companies with comparable scale and financing history.

The current $61B valuation therefore rests primarily on deal-level context and investor signals rather than quantitative peer benchmarking. Key uncertainties include the maturity and revenue trajectory of identified private peers, public market multiples applicability to a pre-exit defense contractor, and whether capital raise velocity ($11B+) reflects fundamental value or frothy late-stage dynamics. A robust valuation range would require either expansion of the comparable set or detailed revenue and margin analysis of Anduril's core programs, neither available in the present dataset.
